concerns.text: FR-001 (Edge Cases) and US-1 require robust outlier filtering (z-score > 3) and logging to `data/qc/filtering_log.json`. Task T015 is marked as incomplete (missing checkbox) and lacks the implementation logic to generate this log, leaving the FR-001 outlier requirement unimplemented.

FR-005 requires fitting a Regularized Linear Regression model (LASSO/Elastic Net) if data is merged. Task T023 is marked as incomplete (missing checkbox) and the analyze report notes it raises `FileNotFoundError` instead of exiting gracefully. The logic to implement the regression model is missing.

FR-006 requires stratifying correlation analysis by age groups (<40, ≥40-<60, ≥60). Task T029 is marked as incomplete (missing checkbox) and lacks the implementation logic for age stratification, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.

SC-002 requires measuring stability by comparing significant taxa counts across normalization methods (DESeq2 vs rarefaction). Task T030 is marked as incomplete (missing checkbox) and lacks the logic to compare normalization methods, leaving SC-002 unimplemented.

The spec (FR-001 to FR-008, SC-001 to SC-005) defines a correlational study with a meta-analytic fallback. It contains NO requirements for 'Mechanistic Grounding' (Phase 6) or 'Mechanistic Gap Analysis' (Phase 8). Tasks T040-T054 (literature synthesis, pathway extraction, future study design) have no matching FR/SC/Plan element. These are orphan tasks representing scope creep.

Tasks T040-T045 are tagged for 'US2' but the spec's US-2 is strictly 'Correlation and Association Analysis'. These tasks (literature query, pathway extraction) do not match the scope of US-2. They appear to be driven by external reviewer comments not present in the current spec.md.
